hook: A personalized neoantigen vaccine plus pembrolizumab cut melanoma recurrence in a phase 3 trial.
hook_turn: cut melanoma recurrence in a phase 3 trial.
summary: In 1137 patients with resected stage IIB to IV melanoma, adding the individualized therapy intismeran to pembrolizumab raised 24-month recurrence-free survival from 70.0% to 82.2% versus placebo. The benefit appeared only after about 6 months, and serious adverse events were slightly more common (23.6% vs 20.3%). Follow-up is a median of 24.6 months, so overall survival is not yet known.
title: Intismeran Autogene plus Pembrolizumab for Resected Stage IIB to IV Melanoma.
